does: Stops a tool call that would lower hub's own protections, so only you change them.

children.does: Stops hubctl in a tool call when it would lower a gate, a guard, a privacy check or a pin, or uninstall hub.
Stops a command that unsets or overrides the marker that tells hub a tool call is running.
Stops writes to hub's settings and state files. Reading them still works.
Tells Claude to ask you to make the change with /hub in Claude Code.
